description:
North star: compile work proportional to input; things nothing uses create no work or artifacts.

Fact (HEAD 5ea6a5830): an extern no caller reaches runs 4 jobs (ExpandFunctionSource, DefineFunction, DeriveStaticCallees, DeriveInputDemand). `def main(), do: 1 + 2` touches fz_op_add_if/ff through the unselected clauses of Kernel.+/2 (lib/kernel.fz:291-293).

Design, revision 3 (proposal ../fz-xxd.10.html, artifact MCMss4qzGKDSW4tKXf8xbL; revisions 1-2 withdrawn: component identity and widened recursive keys both failed):
- R1 self-keyed rows: a row with no variables that convergence_class_at (both flags) and erase_closure_identity leave unchanged keys as itself and asks no Recursive/InputDemand. One gate require_activation_key_facts(root, f, row) replaces the copies in jobs/root.rs, backend.rs, callable_target.rs and semantic.rs; a direct call asks it after contract refinement.
- R3 transport on-cycle: an edge is on a cycle when the callee executable reaches the owner through settled ExecutableFacts call-site targets (direct arm: direct edges only, skipping ClosureCallReturn origins; closure arm: all edges). Cut rule (callee id <= owner id) unchanged.
- R4 body shape from source: extern-ness and @spec are read from the scoped FunctionSource heads; DeriveFunctionContract gated on FunctionDefined; a caller waits once for {Contract if declared, LoweredBody unless extern}.
- Recursive(f) = f reaches itself through StaticCallees (job DeriveRecursive); CallGraphComponent, strong_component, settled_component and statically_reaches are deleted. (Not yet probed.)

Probe (uncommitted, worktree fz-probe): walk_typed 42 -> 32, 1+2 144 -> 102, count 163 -> 112; census of 665 fixtures 182994 -> 146829 jobs with identical output; matrix green.

Blocked by fz-afu.13 and fz-afu.4 (2026-10-02): the four rises (closure_capture_requirement_projection +301, keyword_surface +10, m_userstep_mixed +7, mailbox_closure_enum_hofs +4) and the json_roundtrip ladder change (3216 -> 2246) are order effects, not revision 3's rules: new work starts only when the queue drains (fz-afu.13) and returns publish from a subset of call sites (fz-afu.4). With eager starts, base and revision 3 compile json identically. Re-measure revision 3 on top of both before building; pin nothing schedule-dependent.
title: Nothing unused creates work: a static edge exists only from a clause dispatch can select
